title: When Joy Becomes Your Superpower
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner teaches on the importance of joy and expectation in our relationship with God, highlighting how surrender and receptivity can unlock supernatural power in our lives. By examining Jesus' example and biblical teachings, Pastor Chris shows us how to cultivate a deeper sense of joy and expectation, allowing God to work miraculously in our lives. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge and encourage you to live a more surrendered and expectant life in Christ.
